name: warm-row-selection-and-completeness
body: warm_prepared selects the first committed scan row in redb iteration order whose content_key and cache_key match the tree; rows agreeing on both describe the same tree so any is equivalent, but if two matching rows ever carry divergent refs the first silently wins, so add a deterministic tie-break only if divergent same-key rows become possible. Its completeness check also requires a fact unit for every non-"other" manifest entry, and a tracked apg/config.json is blacklisted from the graph so it carries no unit — warm assembly therefore only hits when the apg/ layout is gitignored; upgrade when the completeness check learns to skip the tool-owned layout.
